title: The predominant binding mode of Palmatine to DNA
authors: Marziogiuseppe Gentile; Francesco Talotta; Jean Christophe Tremblay; Leticia González; Antonio Monari
one_liner_zh: 该文通过长时程分子动力学模拟和增强采样方法，明确小分子巴马汀与DNA的主要结合模式为嵌入，属于广义蛋白/配体-DNA互作体系，方法可迁移至TF-DNA结合机制研究，但对象非TF-DNA。
abstract: Palmatine is a protoberberine alkaloid, which may produce singlet oxygen under visible light irradiation and binds to DNA. The fact that singlet oxygen activation in palmatine may be triggered by environmental conditions, and in particular its interaction with nucleic acids, makes it a most suitable candidate for photodynamic therapy and DNA-targeted non-invasive anticancer strategies. Despite these remarkable properties the actual binding mode between palmatine and DNA has not been resolved, yet. Its elucidation has, indeed, led to contrasting hypothesis. In this contribution by using long-range molecular dynamic simulations and enhanced sampling approaches, we unequivocally identify that intercalation is the dominant binding mode of palmatine with DNA, from either a thermodynamic and kinetic point of view. abstract_zh: 巴马汀是一种原小檗碱类生物碱，在可见光照射下可能产生单线态氧，并能与DNA结合。巴马汀中单线态氧的激活可能由环境条件触发，尤其是其与核酸的相互作用，这一特性使其成为光动力疗法和靶向DNA的非侵入性抗癌策略的理想候选物。尽管具有这些显著特性，巴马汀与DNA之间的实际结合模式尚未得到解决。事实上，对其阐明已导致相互矛盾的假说。在本研究中，通过使用长程分子动力学 (molecular dynamics) 模拟和增强采样方法，我们从热力学和动力学角度明确识别出嵌入是巴马汀与DNA结合的主要模式。TOC图形
